# 1464. Maximum Product of Two Elements in an Array

## Solution 1 (time O(nlog(n)), space O(n))

```python
class Solution(object):
    def maxProduct(self, nums):
        """
        :type nums: List[int]
        :rtype: int
        """
        t = sorted(nums)
        return (t[-1] - 1) * (t[-2] - 1)
```
